title: Kingdom of Württemberg
capsule: The Kingdom of Württemberg was a south German monarchy created by Napoleon in January 1806, when Frederick I was elevated from elector to king in exchange for joining the Confederation of the Rhine. The kingdom gained substantial territory through the Napoleonic reorganization, absorbing Swabian imperial cities and princely enclaves, and adopted a liberal constitution in 1819 under William I that gave it a functioning parliamentary system. It entered the German Empire in 1871 as a constituent state retaining its own army, postal service, and diplomatic rights. King William II abdicated on 30 November 1918 following Germany's defeat in World War I, ending the royal line; Württemberg became a free state and was ultimately merged into Baden-Württemberg in 1952.
